mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: sortdata
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Continuous spike data. N×1 contains spike times only; N×2 contains [spikeTime, clusterID]. Spike times do not need to be sorted. Cluster IDs, when present, must be finite integer-valued numbers.

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: trialOrEvent
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Event onset information. Numeric input is a vector of event times. Struct input must contain a finite scalar .onset field for every element. Events do not need to be sorted, and output is restored to the original event order.

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: window
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Relative event window [windowStart, windowEnd]. Spike selection uses the half-open interval [eventTime+windowStart, eventTime+windowEnd), including the left boundary and excluding the right boundary.

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: clus
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Cluster IDs to retain, for example [1 2 3]. Empty selects all clusters. Requires sortdata to contain a cluster column. Default: [].

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: keepClus
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Whether to retain the cluster-ID column in OutputMode='data'. If false, each trial contains spike times only. Ignored by OutputMode='count' and does not remove cluster metadata from OutputMode='index'. Default: true.

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: OutputMode
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: 'data' returns event-aligned spike arrays; 'count' returns one spike count per event without copying spike data; 'index' returns a compact struct containing startIndex, endIndexExclusive, count, eventTime, spikeTimes, clusters, sourceIndex, and window metadata. Default: 'data'.

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: trial
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Previously segmented trial spike data. Cell elements contain spike-time vectors or [spikeTime, clusterID] matrices. Struct input must contain a .spike field.

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: clus
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Cluster IDs to retain, for example [1 2 3]. Empty selects all clusters. Cluster selection requires trial spike data to contain a second cluster-ID column. Default: [].

mutuallyExclusiveGroup.name: keepClus
mutuallyExclusiveGroup.description: Whether to retain the cluster-ID column after selection. If false, output contains spike times only. Default: false.
